text:
ana: Thinking of a tiny 'Pocket Party' tonight
Bring handhelds, chargers, and any weird controllers. Quick swap of Steam keys on the snack table.
ric: I have my Switch Lite and a bunch of cheap indie keys. Also a micro HDMI if we want to mirror to the conference screen.
samir: Count me in. Can someone bring a USB-C PD brick? my Deck eats batteries.
violet: I can bring a 65W brick and a multi-USB charger. Also proposing a 15min demo slot for each handheld so people can try new games.
chloe: demo slots = yes. I can sign people up. Suggestion: 7pm start, 8:30 mini tournament (celeste speedrun for glory).
habib: I can run the speedrun timer. Also bringing sticky notes to label charger slots.
event-bot: Poll created: Start at 7pm or 7:30pm? React :one: for 7pm, :two: for 7:30pm.
ric: :one:
violet: :one: (earlier is better)
nana: @here RSVP and note if you need a guaranteed charger.
chloe: RSVP I want a charger slot. Also adding a "no-spoilers" note for story games.
samir: I'll bring a portable capture stick if anyone wants clips.
habib: Bringing snacks: chips + a small sweet treat. Vegan? yes, one pack.
nana: Perfect. Setup 6:40, start 7. Stickers and spare SD cards welcome. See you tonight! :controller:
